resources.string: Every 10 dB is roughly half as loud. 20–30 dB is a good starting point.
The tile is already in Quick Settings.

While Extra quiet is on, all audio is cut by the amount above, so the normal volume buttons work across a much quieter range. Turn it on from the Quick Settings tile (swipe down twice, tap the pencil/edit button, and drag \"Extra quiet\" in if you don\'t see it). Long-press the tile to come back here.\n\nIf a particular app isn\'t affected, your phone may not allow global audio effects; apps that support system equalizers (most music players) are handled individually.
